about: What layer 1 of the mockup fidelity gate (test/ui-tokens.test.js) does not hold yet. tokens: a token of app/renderer/tokens.css whose value the app uses today and the mockup's shared rules (app/renderer/ui) contradict; the mockup's value is the target. fonts: a face the mockup's rules ask for that is not bundled. literals: colour and size literals per file that should name a token. The test fails on anything beyond this ledger and on an entry that no longer applies, so it only shrinks; the feature named in gate ends with it empty. Decided by the maintainer, 2026-11-15: every literal becomes a token and there is no allowlist; the mockup's token values win; JetBrains Mono Medium is bundled. m5-ui-tokens-spacing clears the token entries and the literals of app/renderer/ui and of mockup.html, m5-ui-alignment-chrome the font entry, and the alignment features of the regions the rest.

tokens.why: The mockup's ruler is 40 px (18 px locator half, 22 px cursor half); the app's canvas ruler and the track list's head are 32 px.
The mockup's lower-zone tab row is 26 px (and its zone heads 32 px, --zone-head); the app's zone tab rows are 24 px.
A strip meter channel is 6 px in the mockup (9 px on the master); the app draws one 10 px meter slot.
The focused zone's frame is 20 % in the mockup; the app's is 55 %.

fonts.why: The mockup's rules ask for JetBrains Mono at 500 (display values, key hints); only Regular (400) is bundled in app/renderer/fonts, so both the mockup and the app draw those texts in Regular. Decided by the maintainer, 2026-11-15: Medium is bundled (the font file under the OFL text already there, one @font-face, font tests), by m5-ui-alignment-chrome. 600, which the mockup's original web-font link also loaded, is not bundled: no rule asks for it.
